issues.on_page: General government 351,404 (budgetary basis); reconciliation below: 'Eliminate intergovernmental fund transfers (150,000)' from uses
issues.issue: [fixed] Transfer hidden inside spending. The budget schedule's General government line includes the General Fund's transfers out: the p8 reconciliation removes 150,000 of transfers from expenditures. The GAAP statement (p4) shows General Fund expenditures of only 27,073 against transfers out of 325,000 (351,404 - 325,000 = 26,404). Under the hidden-transfer rule, the transfer part must be split out (or a negative contra line added) as an 'other financing' item with split_from and review. As recorded, at least 150,000, and likely 325,000, of transfers is counted as spending.

issues.on_page: Service Fund lines (wages and trustee fees, repairs and maintenance, utilities, payroll taxes...), function 'Service fund' on p2
issues.issue: The Service Fund appears to run the district's utility/sewer service (it collects the 13,100 'Utility revenues'). 'utilities' may be a better function than general government for its object lines. They are already marked 'listed by object'.
This amortizes the deferred bond issuance costs (p5), so it is arguably a debt cost ('debt service interest', including fees) rather than a utility operating cost.

The budget schedule has no utility revenues line, but the GAAP statement shows Utility revenues 13,100 and Miscellaneous 73. Most of 'Other income' is therefore probably utility charges, not truly unidentified miscellaneous revenue.
